label: Selected-for judgment matches the normative truth except in at most an e share of cases
paraphrase: On one distribution of cases, the selected-for judgment B differs from the normative truth M in a set of cases of measure at most e; if the distribution is a probability measure and the agreement event is measurable, B agrees with M with probability at least 1 − e (zero once e ≥ 1). This is a bound on the truth–judgment correlation over that distribution, not on any single case, other distribution or other verdict type.
